concrete_source_findings.finding: Invalid virtual cap returns inside_fraction=0 and COM_inside=false without evaluating winding. This is failed/unknown classification, not measured outside.
concrete_source_findings.final_response_rule: If invalid, retain raw fail-closed result but describe containment as unestablished; independently query the admissible below-lowest-rim domain with two caps and physical-body distances.

concrete_source_findings.finding: Cap is a center fan and validity is topological closure/winding consistency plus a 2D proper-crossing/area test; it does not establish 3D embeddedness, absence of cap/body intersections, integer-unit winding, or distance from the physical body. abs(w)>0.5 also admits multiple winding.
concrete_source_findings.final_response_rule: Inspect raw winding, unit/integer residual, coherent physical orientation, self-intersection/near-boundary ambiguity and two analysis caps. A planar projection crossing can invalidate this cap even if the spatial rim is simple. Empty low-region queries remain unknown, not 0% contained.

concrete_source_findings.finding: All teddy nodes plus rest-mass COM are point tests. Final contact only samples bag vertices, edge midpoints and face centroids against bear volume. These are not whole-tetra containment or continuous triangle-intersection proofs.
concrete_source_findings.final_response_rule: A pass is a pass of sampled criteria. If raw geometry suggests folded-body/triangle crossings, use physical body triangles and bear boundary/tetra geometry to resolve the specific intersection and its depth; never infer volume fraction from node fraction.

concrete_source_findings.finding: Retention checks only first/middle/last saved sample in the final .5 s; phase order uses names and final finger check uses only final q. It does not by itself prove all2s settling retention or absence of regrasp between samples.
concrete_source_findings.final_response_rule: Cross-check actual phase durations/endpoints and all saved final-settle frames, with per-step grip/force flags; report the sampling scope.

concrete_source_findings.finding: Runtime rejects J<.05; frozen final validator requires J>.05. An exact J=.05 is allowed by runtime but rejected by final validation. No evidence this run reaches exact boundary.
concrete_source_findings.final_response_rule: Preserve frozen result and disclose exact equality if encountered; do not change threshold.

concrete_source_findings.finding: Reaction audit takes limits from report.contact_guard.limits; check values independently against frozen original8N/.15Nm/8N rather than treating report thresholds alone as immutable. No evidence of changed limits in this run.
concrete_source_findings.final_response_rule: Explicitly compare final reported limit values and frozen source constants before interpreting reaction pass.
